The '''Vegar Ocean''' is a maritime region associated with eastern Nogoyev. The [[Nogoyevian War of Independence]] source places [[Kingdom of Nogoyev|Nogoyev]] along the Vegar Ocean and describes naval operations, blockades, and coastal defense as important parts of the war.

This draft is a geographic bridge page. Its exact boundaries, neighboring seas, and map placement should be confirmed against AGGSWorld map references before final publication.
